title: Vayeitzei 5752: Asleep on the Site of the Beis Hamikdash?!
blurb: Yaakov Avinu, fleeing the wrath of his brother Esav, arrived in Beis El as the sun was setting unexpectedly. As a result of the sudden sunset, he went to sleep there for the night. title: Looking for a Niggun Sung by the Rebbe? Now You Can Find It
blurb: A new groundbreaking website allows users to easily search, find and listen to niggunim sung in the Rebbe’s presence at farbrengens, rallies, and countless other occasions. What once required hours of searching through dozens of seforim and hundreds of audio recordings can now be done with just the click of a button.

title: A Little Boy’s Unforgettable Hug With the Rebbe
blurb: In a podcast interview, Rabbi Moshe Stiefel , a shliach in Holland, shares fascinating stories and memories spanning his childhood in Atlanta, his years learning in 770, the period after Chof Zayin Adar when Lubavitch moved into the hospital in Manhattan, and the way he lives with the Rebbe following Gimmel Tammuz.
